label: Late-episode GO after an a1 -> S2 rare rewarded trial (switch-to-a2 cue near episode end)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass), never at D2 and barely at D1, and only in the last ~15 trials of an episode (ep_trial >= 80; 90% of mass in trials 90-99; matches the lowest value-head bin, value < 5.2, which holds 93% of mass). Within that late window, the strongest and most precise activations come at GO right after a trial where the agent chose a1, got a rare transition to S2 and was rewarded (the model-based cue to switch to a2); the agent usually does switch to a2 here. Predicate (observed variables only: phase, episode position, previous choice/transition/reward) gives dev precision 0.87, recall 0.50, mass recall 0.71, F1 0.64. Generalising to any previously rewarded S2 visit (adding a2-common-rewarded) or to all late GO steps raises recall to 0.70-0.96 but cuts precision to 0.05-0.14. The remaining ~29% of mass is weaker activations at other late-episode GO steps (e.g. after a2 common rewarded or after unrewarded trials). Magnitude is highest for the a1-rare-rewarded case in trials 90-99. It does not fire before trial 80, at D2, or when the reward input is 1 at that step.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=GO & value_bin=decile 1 (9 = highest) (+3.43), phase=GO & ep_dec=8 (+3.08), phase=GO & last=a1 S2 r (+2.71), phase=GO & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+2.68), phase=D1 & before=a2 S2 u (+2.68), phase=GO & ep_dec=9 (+2.36). Lower it: prev_state=1 (-4.48), before=a2 S2 r (-4.41), phase=GO & last=a2 S2 u (-3.65), last=a1 S1 u (-2.63).
